[1/2] Keystone testbed cycle: cover playtest canon/signals, policies, transcripts/diffs, reports and fairness verdicts

impact_assessment.why: playtest is the seeded bot/fairness layer but the testbed has no direct coverage of canonical hashes, policy behavior, transcript diffs, reports or fairness branches.
impact_assessment.benefits: Five tests pin canon/signal readers, scripted/random/greedy policies, transcript replay/diffs, report envelopes and fair/unfair/unknown fairness verdicts with local fixtures.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: in-memory games and temp-free runs; no game/sim/hash change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Small frame budgets and local contract games, full suite, determinism and project gates.
